case_plan.original_pools: Every pool in research/catalog.json, with union explicitly equal to the full 34-name frozen universe.
case_plan.joint_optical_leader_removal: Full frozen universe excluding sz300308, sz300502, sz300394.
case_plan.single_name_only: One case for each of the 34 frozen symbols, diagnostic concentration evidence.
case_plan.leave_one_out: One case for each of the 34 frozen symbols removed from the full universe.
case_plan.sector_removal: One case for each sector in the frozen catalog.
case_plan.deterministic_subsets: Using numpy default_rng(seed=34), six fixed samples for each size 2,3,5,8,13,22,26,33, exactly matching the historical formal case generator.
case_plan.common_five_exhaustive: All 31 nonempty subsets of the frozen common-five pool.
case_plan.cardinality_coverage: Using default_rng(seed=35), one fixed sample for every size 2..33 not already in the deterministic-subset size set, exactly matching the historical formal generator.
case_plan.prefix: Exact candidate and control equality between the full frozen snapshot and a prefix cut at the original historical index 500 for union.
case_plan.candidate_parameter_stability: NOT_APPLICABLE_NUMERIC_GRID: the promoted candidate has no tunable numeric candidate parameter. Stability is assessed by fixed universe removals/subsets, execution stresses and prefix causality rather than inventing a post-selection parameter neighborhood.

policies.control: Exact candidate Parameters(False), already tested equivalent to trend_book.
policies.treatment: Exact source-bound candidate Parameters(True) at canonical source identity; no parameter mutation.
policies.equal_weight: Additional benchmark for every original catalog pool.

interpretation.alpha_priority: Do not reject solely for MDD/orders/turnover during this expanded alpha/generalization diagnostic.
interpretation.generalization: Report the full distribution versus exact control and buy-hold. No failed case may be deleted or hidden.
interpretation.final_acceptance: This matrix does not by itself waive the original final production risk/execution/reference-comparison contract.

execution.assignment: Stable case index modulo 4 after the complete deterministic plan is generated before the first account run.
execution.raw_evidence: Each shard preserves source-bound raw account results and metrics. Aggregation must retain all shards and verify hashes before producing summary evidence.

prohibitions: No case deletion after seeing results
No reuse of evidence from a non-equivalent source/data/runtime identity as proof of this candidate
